name: Admissions MedPAR
description: Linked MBSF and MedPAR admission data for Medicare beneficiaries, with demographic, enrollment, Fee-for-Service, age-65-plus, disability, geography, diagnosis, stay, and payment fields. This release also provides county and ZCTA yearly and sparse daily counts, stratified counts, and population-specific admission-rate covariates.

license.name: No license, user must be under Data User Agreement (DUA)

name: manual
description: manual

name: MBSF-MedPAR Denominator File
description: Beneficiary-year denominator file linked to MedPAR claims. Records include beneficiary identifiers, enrollment year, geography, birth and death information, demographics, HMO/Medicare Advantage coverage, dual eligibility, buy-in coverage, entitlement reason codes, age, and Fee-for-Service indicators.

content.bene_id: String: Encrypted Beneficiary ID (CCW Encrypted Beneficiary ID Number)
content.year: Int64: Reference year of enrollment data (Reference Year from MBSF)
content.zcta: String: ZIP Code Tabulation Area mapped using https://github.com/NSAPH-Data-Processing/zip2zcta_master_xwalk
content.county: String: County FIPS code mapped via https://github.com/NSAPH-Data-Processing/us_census_geoboundaries
content.state: String: State code (SSA 2-digit) mapped via https://github.com/NSAPH-Data-Processing/us_census_geoboundaries and converted to state abbreviations
content.age_dob: Int64: Age calculated as year of data - year of birth (valid range: 65-115)
content.yob: Int64: Year of birth extracted from Date of Birth
content.sex: String: Sex of the beneficiary. Code values: 0 = Unknown, 1 = Male, 2 = Female.
content.race: String: SSA Beneficiary Race Code (Base). Code values: 0 = Unknown, 1 = White, 2 = Black, 3 = Other, 4 = Asian, 5 = Hispanic, 6 = North American Native.
content.race_rti: String: RTI-assigned enhanced race classification. Code values: 0 = Unknown, 1 = Non-Hispanic White, 2 = Black or African-American, 3 = Other, 4 = Asian/Pacific Islander, 5 = Hispanic, 6 = American Indian/Alaska Native.
content.hmo: Int32: HMO enrollment status. Code values: 1 = enrolled in Medicare Advantage (HMO), 0 = not enrolled.
content.hmo_cvg_count: Int32: Number of months with HMO enrollment
content.hmo_indicators: List[String]: Monthly indicators of HMO (Medicare Advantage) enrollment (12-month indicators)
content.dual: Int32: Dual eligibility status. Code values: 1 = dual eligible, 0 = not dual.
content.dual_cvg_count: Int32: Number of months with dual eligibility; NULL if no monthly record exists
content.dual_indicators: List[String]: Monthly dual eligibility indicators (12 months)
content.buyin: Int32: Buy-in status for Medicare A/B. Code values: 1 = any state buy-in months, 0 = none.
content.buyin_indicators: List[String]: Monthly Medicare A/B entitlement and buy-in status (12-month indicators)
content.buyin_cvg_count: Int32: Number of months with state buy-in coverage
content.orec: Int32: Original reason for Medicare entitlement. Code values: 0 = Old Age and Survivors Insurance (OASI), 1 = Disability Insurance Benefits (DIB), 2 = End-stage Renal Disease (ESRD), 3 = both DIB and ESRD.
content.curec: Int32: Current reason for Medicare entitlement. Code values: 0 = Old Age and Survivors Insurance (OASI), 1 = Disability Insurance Benefits (DIB), 2 = End-stage Renal Disease (ESRD), 3 = both DIB and ESRD.
content.ffs_ind: Int32: Fee-for-Service eligibility indicator. Code values: 1 = Fee-for-Service eligible, 0 = enrolled in Medicare Advantage (HMO).
content.disability_ind: Int32: Disability entitlement indicator. Code values: 1 = disability entitlement, 0 = no disability entitlement.
content.age_65plus_ind: Int32: Age 65 or older indicator. Code values: 1 = age 65 or older, 0 = under age 65.

name: MedPAR Claims
description: MedPAR admissions linked to MBSF denominator records. Records include beneficiary eligibility indicators, admission and discharge dates, diagnosis codes, stay characteristics, and Medicare payment fields.

content.year: INTEGER: Calendar year of the source MedPAR file
content.adm_id: VARCHAR: Admission identifier, unique per hospitalization record
content.adm_day_of_week: BIGINT: Day of week of admission
content.ss_ls_snf_cd: VARCHAR: Short-stay, long-stay, or skilled nursing facility indicator code
content.primary_diagnosis: VARCHAR: Principal diagnosis code for the stay
content.diagnoses: VARCHAR[]: Diagnosis codes recorded for the stay
content.non_external_primary: INTEGER: Indicator that the principal diagnosis is not an external-cause diagnosis
content.non_external_all: INTEGER[]: Indicators identifying non-external-cause diagnosis codes
content.los_day_cnt: INTEGER: Length of stay in days
content.drg_price_amt: DOUBLE: Diagnosis Related Group price amount
content.bene_prmry_pyr_amt: DOUBLE: Amount paid by the beneficiary primary payer or other insurance
content.bene_pta_coinsrnc_amt: DOUBLE: Beneficiary Part A coinsurance amount
